title: Release image pack: quickstart & onboarding callouts with before/after UI
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a comprehensive image pack for the upcoming console release that supports the onboarding / quickstart docs and the public changelog blog. Deliverables include feature callout overlays, paired before/after UI screenshots for the new quickstart flow, social-optimized hero images, and thumbnail sets for documentation pages.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Finalized Figma file with annotated components and export-ready frames. 2) PNG/JPEG exports in specified sizes for docs and blog. 3) Before/after screenshot pairs showing current UI and updated quickstart flow with callouts present. 4) Hand-off assets uploaded to Drive + figma prototype linked in PR. 5) PM sign-off and a short changelog image gallery attached to the release notes.
tasks: Audit current quickstart screenshots and note visual inconsistencies
Design primary hero image for blog (1200x628) with 3 feature callouts
Create three 800x450 doc thumbnails (plain, annotated, mobile mock)
Capture 4 before UI screenshots from staging (Chrome, 1440x900)
Design 4 after UI screenshots with step-by-step callout overlays
Export all assets at 1x and 2x for retina displays
Prepare Figma handoff file with slices and naming conventions
Upload final pack to Drive and update release notes with links
assets_spec: Hero: 1200x628 (JPG for blog, PNG for internal with transparency), Doc thumbnails: 800x450 and 400x225 retina versions, Web inline images: 1024x512 max. Callouts use Redwood brand colors, 16px rounded corner tooltip style, arrow + short caption. Include source .fig and .svg exports for vector elements. Filenames: release_console-2026_hero.jpg, quickstart_before_1.png, quickstart_after_1_annotated.png, quickstart_thumbs_v1.zip
screenshot_guidelines: Use staging environment at build tag release-2026.03; disable dev overlays and email banners. Browser: Chrome 112, window size 1440x900. Capture raw screenshots and then produce annotated variants in Figma. Maintain consistent padding and system font fallback. For mobile mocks, use iPhone 14 frame and export at 3x.
